s: Rur, Roer (a river in Belgium, Germany and the Netherlands, tributary of the Meuse)
Rur.et:
From Middle High German Rure, Roir.
Until the earlier 20th century, the spellings Roer, Ruhr, Rur were all used, Rur being actually the rarest. It then became standardised, however, because it was more German-looking than Roer and avoided confusion with the We…
